reconstruction_summary: V4 = Linear single-track yaw-rate (platform params; Cf=Cr=1.5e5 per agent's stalled fit) minus per-segment straight-line bias minus a Ridge residual learner trained on the agent's 60 Mach-E training segments.
notes: V4 = V3 (Linear single-track, fit C_alpha) with per-segment yaw-gyro bias (|delta|<0.01 samples) - Ridge residual learner on [v, |a_y|, |delta|, sign(ddelta)]; Cf=Cr=1.5e5 N/rad (agent's fit_c_alpha stalled at x0 per REPORT). Ridge trained ONCE on 60 Mach-E segments (agent's training set), then applied to all 545 canonical Ford segments. Platform-specific m, I_z, l_f, l_r, L are used for V3. Agent's original V4 used LOO across the 60 Mach-E training segments; here we use a single Ridge fit on all 60 (their 'shipped' model). Applying a Mach-E-trained residual learner to F-150 Lightning is an out-of-domain extension implicit in the canonical pooling, but the agent never validated it.
